The building is expected to reopen as a community heritage hub in early 2027.

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Coyote vs. Acme debuted strongly in second place at the box office.  The film earned an estimated fifteen point five million dollars over the weekend.  This release follows Warner Bros. decision to cancel the movie for a tax write-off.  Spider-Man: Brand New Day remained the top-grossing film for a fifth week.  The Dog Stars, a new release, opened in fifth place with eight million dollars.
title: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' beats 'Avatar 2'; third highest-grossing film of all time

author: TNN
description: Priyanka Gandhi Vadra has urged Prime Minister Narendra Modi to order an FIR.  This appeal follows an alleged "purification" of a rally venue in Haldwani.  Rahul Gandhi previously alleged BJP-RSS elements were responsible for the incident.  The Congress leader stated the act violated the Constitution and SC/ST Act.  She questioned the government's inaction over the alleged crime.
title: File FIR against those who did 'purification': Priyanka to PM Modi
